metadata.remarks: Network Egress Discipline defines the capability that governs outbound network connectivity. Unlike traditional perimeter models that implicitly allow egress, this pattern requires explicit authorization, classification, and monitoring of outbound traffic destinations. Egress discipline reduces data exfiltration risk, prevents abuse of trusted connectivity, and supports cyber resiliency by limiting adversary freedom of action.
